en.dr-ali-peiravi: 4-64 (The compiler of the book narrated) that his father - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Sa’ed ibn Abdullah quoted Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd, on the authority of Suleiman ibn Ja’far al-Ja’fari, on the authority of Al-Ridha (MGB), on the authority of his father (MGB), on the authority of his forefathers (MGB),

“God’s Prophet (MGB) liked four tribes: the Helpers (Ansar); Abdul Qyas; Aslam; and Tamim tribe. God’s Prophet (MGB) disliked four tribes: the Umayyads; the Hanif tribe; the Thaqif tribe; and the Hazil tribe. The Prophet (MGB) said, ‘My mother who delivered me was not from the Bakr tribe or the Thaqif tribe.’ He (MGB) also said, ‘There are some noble people in all tribes except for the Umayyads.’”
